ValidationRule.description: This rule will prohibit an MCA from changing an opportunity stage to PreQual, Approval, Docs Out, Submission, Conversion or Funded.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( $User.Title = "National Account Executive",$User.Title = "National Sales Manager",$User.Title = "Account Executive"), ISCHANGED( StageName ), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Credit Submittal"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Credit Review"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Docs In"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Up For Funding"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Pre-Fund"), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(StageName) , "Funded"), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(StageName) , "Closed Won")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sales may not change the opportunity to the Stage selected. Please try again.
